releases.body:
One appearance button that cycles light, dark and system.

And a fix for the island closing itself the moment it opened to ask for a permission: the window never holds focus, so the app taking focus back collapsed it mid-question. An island with a pending approval now stays put until it is answered. The bottom bar also reads on the warning background.
The first island: a live tab for every OpenCode session, streamed answers, in-place approvals and a bar you can size.
